satellites.title: A Faculty of Mindfulness
satellites.evidence: The five faculties listed in the Abhidharmakośa include 念根 between effort and concentration: a situated use of mindfulness.

satellites.title: Even Ten Recollections
satellites.evidence: The vow of the Sutra of Immeasurable Life numbered eighteenth reads: 至心信樂，欲生我國，乃至十念，若不生者，不取正覺 — beings who wish with sincere trust to be born in that land, “even with ten recollections”. Later Pure Land teachers read these 念 as recitations of the Buddha’s name, so 念 came to mean recollecting and saying at once.
satellites.caveat: Whether 十念 means ten thoughts or ten recitations is a classic Pure Land dispute that the passage alone does not settle; numbering the vows is conventional.
